item.title: Oregon's lack of snow sets new records, may increase wildfire risk

(KOIN) – The lack of snow across Oregon is setting records, according to climatologists. “For snow and precipitation from this day going forward, it is really unlikely that we will catch up to normal for sure,” Larry O’Neill, the state climatologist of Oregon, said. item.title: Rollover crash in Vancouver traps person inside car, injures 2
item.description: Two people were hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries after a rollover crash in Vancouver on Thursday morning, and the Vancouver Police Department is investigating the cause.

item.title: Senator Merkley introduces bill to end grocery price gouging
item.description: Senator Jeff Merkley (D-OR) introduced a bill on Thursday aiming to stop grocery price gouging.

item.title: Clackamas County man caught selling stolen industrial heater on Facebook Marketplace: officials
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) -- A 33-year-old man is facing multiple charges after police say he tried to sell an industrial heater stolen from a Happy Valley construction site on Facebook Marketplace. Officials say they originally began an investigation in January after three industrial heaters were reported stolen from a construction site on Southeast Hornaday Avenue. [...]

item.title: Felon being pursued by Clackamas County deputies caused fatal 3-car crash on I-205, officials say
item.description: A three-car crash has left one person dead after a speeding driver lost control and crashed into another vehicle in Clackamas County, authorities said.

item.title: Is there a chance of snow in Portland next week?
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) -- It's been a mild and snow-free winter for much of the Pacific Northwest, but a mid-February system will bring snow elevations down. item.title: Manhunt underway for Salem food delivery driver accused of stabbing coworker during attempted sexual assault
item.description: Salem police are searching for Daniel Ray Myers, 62, who is accused of attempting to murder a woman in his car and sexually assaulting her, and are urging anyone who comes into contact with him to remain cautious as he is believed to have a gun.

item.title: 'A landmark': Sheridan Fruit Company set to close after 110 years in business
item.description: Sheridan Fruit Company, a landmark in Portland's Central Eastside, is officially closing Friday after 110 years in business.

item.title: 'You don't belong in my country': Trans woman attacked at Portland MAX stop, court docs say
item.description: A Portland man is facing multiple charges, including first-degree bias crime, after he allegedly attacked a woman while she was waiting at a MAX platform on Sunday.

item.title: 'Very disheartening': Urban League of Portland headquarters closes due to uninhabitable conditions
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) — Portland’s oldest civil rights organization says it can no longer operate out of its historic headquarters, citing serious safety and maintenance concerns.
